name: splitter
title: Splitter
description: Two panes and the handle between them that sets how they share the space.
use: Two panes a reader resizes: a file list beside an editor, an editor over a terminal. The stylesheet draws and lays out; a script moves the handle.

instead.when: The line between two sections does not move
One region scrolls and nothing is resized

keyboard.action: Between panes side by side, make the first pane smaller or larger by a step; the other way around from right to left
Between stacked panes, make the first pane smaller or larger by a step
Move the handle to the least or the greatest size, its aria-valuemin or aria-valuemax

classes.name: splitter
classes.description: The container: first pane, handle, second pane, side by side or stacked by the handle's aria-orientation

classes.name: splitter-pane
classes.description: A pane; it scrolls by itself

classes.name: splitter-handle
classes.description: The focusable role="separator" between the panes: a hairline with a 9px target, 25px on touch screens. Its label names what it resizes; aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax are percentages of the first pane

states.name: horizontal
states.description: The panes stack and the handle is a horizontal line; without it the panes are side by side

states.name: disabled
states.description: The line stays a hairline and takes no pointer

properties.name: --splitter-size
properties.description: The first pane's size; the script writes it
